watermark_mechanism: synthetic challenge-response associations, no malicious outputs
limitations: Tests paraphrases of previously trained keys; does not prove generalization to unseen keys.
One small LLM may not memorize 25 synthetic associations with LoRA; failure is possible.
Same-sized training sets swap 100 ordinary examples for 100 marked examples; clean task composition changes slightly.
Private challenge answers and verification prompts must not be published with released training data in a real ownership system.
